definitions.explanation: A missile designed to strike targets at relatively short distances, typically under about 1,000 kilometers. Contrasts with medium- and long-range missiles.

examples.japanese: {短距離|たんきょり}ミサイルを{発射|はっしゃ}した。
{短距離|たんきょり}ミサイルは{近|ちか}い{目標|もくひょう}を{狙|ねら}う。
examples.english: Short-range missiles are aimed at nearby targets.

examples.japanese: {今回|こんかい}{発射|はっしゃ}されたのは、{射程|しゃてい}の{短|みじか}い{短距離|たんきょり}ミサイルだとみられる。
examples.english: The missile launched this time is believed to be a short-range one with a limited firing range.

notes:
A compound of {短距離|たんきょり} (short distance) and ミサイル (missile). One of the standard range categories used in news coverage of missile tests and defense policy.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {短距離|たんきょり}ミサイルを{発射|はっしゃ}する: to launch a short-range missile
- {短距離|たんきょり}{弾道|だんどう}ミサイル: a short-range ballistic missile
- {複数|ふくすう}の{短距離|たんきょり}ミサイル: multiple short-range missiles

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {長距離|ちょうきょり}ミサイル: long-range missile — reaches far more distant targets
- {中距離|ちゅうきょり}ミサイル: medium-range missile — the intermediate range category

cross_references.reading: ちょうきょりみさいる
